# 🐙 GitHub 配置指南

此文件包含建議的 GitHub 倉庫設置，幫助提高項目的可發現性和專業度。

## 📝 倉庫描述

### 簡短描述 (Required - max 130 chars)

```
AI-powered food writing copilot for Xiaohongshu. Mock workflow, localStorage persistence.
```

或

```
Frontend-first AI food writer assistant for Xiaohongshu with intelligent suggestions.
```

### 詳細描述 (Optional - About section)

```
Xiaohongshu Food Writing Copilot

A frontend-first AI writing assistant that helps users quickly create engaging food 
posts for Xiaohongshu. Features an intelligent suggestion system, draft revision tracking, 
and full localStorage persistence. Built with Next.js, React 19, and TypeScript.

🎯 Current: Mock AI with rule-based suggestions (Phase 0)
🔮 Future: Real LLM integration, user accounts, cloud sync

Perfect for learning Next.js architecture, creating writing tools, or building Xiaohongshu automation.
```

## ✅ 設置步驟

1. **進入倉庫設置**
   - 在你的 GitHub 倉庫主頁
   - 點擊右上角的 ⚙️ **Settings**

2. **更新基本信息**
   - 找到 "About" 部分（右側欄）
   - 點擊編輯圖標 ✏️
   - 添加簡短描述 (max 130 chars)
   - 選擇主題標籤（見上方建議）
   - 添加網站 URL（如有）
   - 選擇許可證（MIT）

3. **配置 Discussions**（可選）
   - 在 Settings → Features 中啟用 "Discussions"
   - 創建歡迎帖子

4. **設置 GitHub Pages**（可選）
   - 在 Settings → Pages 中選擇部署來源
   - 關閉（如果托管在其他地方）

5. **添加徽章到 README**
   ```markdown
   [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/yourusername/rednote-agent?style=social)](https://github.com/yourusername/rednote-agent)
   [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/license/yourusername/rednote-agent)](LICENSE)
   [![Open in GitHub Codespaces](https://github.com/codespaces/badge.svg)](https://codespaces.new/yourusername/rednote-agent)
   ```

## 🎯 倉庫描述副本（可複製粘貼）

### 簡短副本 #1
```
AI-powered food writing copilot for Xiaohongshu. Mock workflow, intelligent suggestions, 
localStorage persistence. Built with Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript.
```

### 簡短副本 #2
```
Frontend-first writing assistant for Xiaohongshu food posts. Features intelligent 
suggestions, revision tracking, and full client-side storage. Next.js + React 19.
```

### 詳細副本
```
🍜 Xiaohongshu Food Writing Copilot

An intelligent writing assistant that helps creators craft engaging food posts for 
Xiaohongshu. Completely frontend-based with localStorage persistence.

✨ Features:
• Mock AI with 6 intelligent suggestion rules
• Real-time draft suggestions and corrections
• Complete revision history tracking
• Chinese input IME support
• All data stored locally (no backend required)

🛠️ Built with:
• Next.js 16.2.1 + React 19
• TypeScript 5
• Tailwind CSS 4
• Turbopack

📖 Perfect for:
• Learning Next.js architecture
• Building writing tools
• Understanding state management
• Xiaohongshu content creators

Phase 0 of development complete. Ready for API integration and real LLM support.
```

## 📊 GitHub Statistics 預覽

- 🔄 Forks（根據實用性）
- 👀 Watchers（根據活躍度）
- 📈 Insights（流量和貢獻）
